title: Vacuum, canonical-scalar, and single-Proca limits
question: Do the production equations recover vacuum CCZ4 as atmosphere support vanishes, canonical Klein-Gordon dynamics when the scalar decouples, and two independent symmetric Proca sectors when mixing and sources vanish?
prediction: The CCZ4 source error decreases with at least 1.5 order in carrier floor, the scalar mode matches its analytic frequency and time reverse within 1e-8, the homogeneous condensed source vanishes, and isolated Proca sectors neither cross-excite nor violate field relabeling above 1e-13.
falsifier: Any registered limit fails its convergence, analytic-solution, static-source, decoupling, or relabeling tolerance.
controls: Vacuum comparison uses the same perturbed geometry with exactly zero CCZ4 matter sources.
The scalar comparison uses the analytic Fourier solution with frequency sqrt(k squared plus mass squared).
Scalar time reversal flips Pi while retaining varphi and Phi_i.
The Proca comparison sets mixing, sources, damping, and cleaners to zero with equal kinetic and mass coefficients.
seed_rationale: All profiles, limits, and integration parameters are deterministic.
